description: A small Python CLI developed by several coding agents at once, with seeded gaps in the agent workflow and its tooling.

must_find.AGENT-02: the brief template has no base revision, allowed paths, reserved identifiers, verification, or report format
must_find.AGENT-03: AGENTS.md merges a branch as soon as its agent reports green; nobody checks the claim on the revision
must_find.AGENT-04: AGENTS.md moves work between worktrees with git stash, which every worktree of a repository shares
must_find.ARCH-04: scripts/wait_for.sh waits with no deadline on a pattern its own command line matches, and stop_workers.sh kills by pattern
must_find.QUAL-10: hooks/run_guard.sh blocks every command when python3 or guard.py is missing, and no test covers those failure modes
must_find.TEST-08: the worker test looks for leftover processes host-wide by a marker every run shares

must_not_flag.SEC-09: the product has no model or LLM features; agents only develop it
must_not_flag.CI-02: actions are pinned to full commit SHAs
must_not_flag.CI-03: contents: read permissions and persist-credentials: false
must_not_flag.OPS-03: a local command-line tool, not a service in operation
must_not_flag.OPS-04: a local command-line tool, not a deployed service
must_not_flag.TEST-09: security level 1 and no mutation testing in use
